title: Cap. IX Arg. 8 Sol cont.: Augustine — infants go into the mildest of all damnation, demons into the bitterest; degrees in eternal damnation unknown
pass_a_gloss: Now truly, howsoever God damns little ones contaminated and bound by original sin alone, and also damns the demons guilty of actual and nefarious rebellion, yet in the mode and degree of the punishment inflicted there is a huge difference. For infants (as Augustine well, De peccat. mer. et remiss. l. 1. cap. 16.) go forth into the mildest of all damnation; the demons into damnation by far the bitterest. But no edge of human wit can discern how many degrees of punishments there can be in the same eternal damnation: and therefore this argumentation is inconsequent, Little ones are damned on account of original sin, and the Devils are damned only on account of actual sin, Therefore little ones are more rigidly treated.
pass_b_english: However God damns infants stained and bound by original sin alone, and also damns demons guilty of actual wicked rebellion, there is a huge difference in the mode and degree of the punishment inflicted. Infants (as Augustine well says, De peccat. mer. et remiss. 1.16) go into the mildest of all damnation; demons into damnation far the bitterest. No edge of human wit can tell how many degrees of pains there may be in the same eternal damnation. So this argument does not follow: Infants are damned for original sin, and Devils only for actual sin; therefore infants are treated more rigidly.
source_text: Jam vero, utcunque Deus damnet parvulos solo originali peccato contaminatos et constrictos, ac damnet etiam diabolos actualis et nefariae rebellionis reos, tamen in modo et gradu poenae inflictiae ingens discrimen est. Nam infantes (ut bene Augustinus, De peccat. mer. et remiss. l. 1. cap. 16.) exeunt in damnatione omnium mitissima; daemones in damnatione longe acerbissima. Nulla autem acies ingenii humani potest discernere, quot possunt esse gradus poenarum in eadem damnatione aeterna: ac proinde inconsequens est haec argumentatio, Parvuli damnantur ob peccatum originale, et Diaboli tantum damnantur ob peccatum actuale, Ergo parvuli rigidius tractantur.
